questions.resolution: Yes if, between the question date and the deadline, the electricity system operator instructs planned rota disconnections of household or business customers in Great Britain (e.g. under the Electricity Supply Emergency Code) because of supply shortage. Voluntary paid demand-reduction schemes and fault-related outages do not count.

questions.text: Will Russia launch a full-scale military invasion of Ukraine?

Limited deployments into the separatist-held areas alone do not count.

questions.text: Will the armed forces of any NATO member engage in combat with Russian forces in or over Ukraine?
questions.resolution: Yes if uniformed forces of a NATO member state, acting under that state's command, exchange fire with Russian forces in Ukraine or its airspace, as acknowledged by that state or reported by two major news organisations. Volunteers, contractors, trainers and intelligence support do not count.
